messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered -> service=redwood-inference-api | env=eu-west | symptom=p99 latency > 1200ms over 10m (SLO burn 18%). Pager: inference-slo-policy.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: PD#INC-48291. Auto-notify rotation.

liam: acked. I'm on call. Starting checklist.

sophie: gl — quick snapshot from console shows spike correlated with model-rerank-2025 variant. seen increased GPU mem pressure on :gpu-pool-eu-west:.

maya: confirming p95 also drifting up but p99 is the sharpest. dashboards -> https://console.redwood/observability/d/latency?panel=inference-eu-west : looks like KV cache miss rate jumped at 12:02 UTC.

liam: ok first step: route traffic off heavy rerank variant. I'll trigger a routing override to model:small-rerank-v2-fallback for 20% of traffic.

liam: running command:```sh
# route 20% to fallback
rclient route --service inference --region eu-west --from model-rerank-2025 --to small-rerank-v2-fallback --pct 20
```

deploy-bot: Routing change queued, applying to 3 pods.

sophie: also seeing a spike in KV eviction logs: ```WARN kvcache key_evicted hotkey=slot-user:12345 rate=900/s``` likely hotkey storms from batch jobs. Any customer runs nightly rerank?

maya: customer-success pinged; looks like one partner did a large reindex job around the same time. CS says they started at 11:55 UTC. Could be correlated.

dave: I'll scale up the inference autoscaler and bump max_replicas by +3 to relieve queueing.

dave: command:```yaml
# autoscaler patch
spec:
  maxReplicas: 12
  targetCPU: 65
```

deploy-bot: Autoscaler patch applied — scaling up. New pods creating (pod-80/81/82).

liam: good. also enabling prefix KV cache warmup for top 1000 keys to mitigate misses. running warmup job.

liam: warmup job logs: ```INFO warming keys 1000 complete in 18s```

incident-bot: PD update -> INC-48291 status=acknowledged by liam, severity=high.

sophie: after routing change + autoscale, p99 back down to ~800ms, SLO burn dropped to 4%.

liam: keeping traffic reroute and autoscale for 10m to confirm stability. Will follow up with rollback plan if stable.

maya: if it reappears, plan B: enable quantized model variant on fallback nodes and reduce max batch size for rerank requests. That reduces throughput slightly but cuts tail latency.

liam: noted. tagging @sophie @maya for postmortem. dave, keep an eye on pod restarts and GPU OOM logs.

dave: watching. no OOMs so far. pod-80 reports load balanced across GPUs.

liam: PD note: added runbook link https://runbooks.redwood/slo-burn for timeline + mitigation steps.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-48291 -> Status: monitoring. Next update due in 15m.

sophie: customer-impact assessment: partner X saw ~3% increased latency on their jobs during spike window, no errors. CS informed.

liam: plan for handoff: I'll keep this open for 30m, then hand to next oncall if stable. If metrics hold, we'll close after 1hr and start a short RCA.

maya: adding a temporary alert mute for less severe noise on KV eviction metric to avoid paging the rotation again while we investigate root cause.

liam: mute applied. thanks team. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Routing override remains active (20% fallback) — manual rollback command: `rclient route --undo last`

liam: last check — p99=720ms, SLO burn=2%. I'll update PD and mark monitoring.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-48291 -> Transitioned to monitoring by liam.

liam: closing thread for now, will open follow-up RCA thread with timeline and action items.
